title: CloudServe support system
description: NFR-05: what the system decided, and why. Every panel reads a metric exported by /metrics/prometheus, which is itself a view of the decision log rather than of in-process counters — so a restart loses nothing. ops/metrics_reference.txt lists what is exported and a test fails if a panel queries anything else.

panels.title: Automation is switched off
panels.description: FR-16. When this reads 1 every ticket escalates by rule, and the escalation rate below will be 100% for that reason rather than a quality collapse. FR-16 §7 recorded that nothing alerted on this; this panel is the answer.

panels.title: Decisions recorded
panels.description: NFR-05 asks for 100% of decisions logged. This is the count the reconciliation in the harness report is measured against.

panels.title: Escalation rate
panels.description: The business number from the PRD. Read it with the panel below: an escalation for provider_unavailable is an availability problem, not a quality one, and the 2026-09-28 gate run showed how easily the two are confused.

panels.title: Provider requests
panels.description: NFR-07's spend figure, from the rows themselves. A jump here without a jump in decisions means retries.

panels.title: Why tickets escalated
panels.description: The single most useful panel for a support manager: which rule is sending work to people. FR-09's four intents are expected here; a spike in ungrounded_draft means the drafter and the documentation disagree, and a spike in provider_unavailable means the model, not the tickets.

panels.title: Guardrail blocks by check
panels.description: The Governance Framework's five checks. A reply blocked here was never sent: these are the failures the system caught, not the ones it made.

panels.title: Answered and escalated over time
panels.description: Rates rather than totals, so a change of pace is visible. The two lines crossing is the signal the PRD's first-contact-resolution target is about.

panels.title: Rows by stage, and the thresholds in force
panels.description: Which stage each logged row came from (ingest, routing, generation, validation, handover), and the confidence and relevance thresholds this deployment is running — so a reader never has to guess whether a placeholder was replaced.
